commentary: Today, the iron ore market underwent a contract rollover, with the most-traded contract switching to the I2505 contract. It remained stable in the morning but slightly declined in the aŌernoon. Throughout the day, it ﬂuctuated downward, ulƟmately closing at 802, with a daily drop of 0.8%. Traders showed moderate willingness to sell, while steel mills purchased as needed. Today's market transacƟon atmosphere was average. In Shandong, the mainstream transacƟon prices for PB ﬁnes were 790-795 yuan/mt, down 5 yuan/mt from yesterday; in Tangshan, the transacƟon prices for PB ﬁnes were 800-805 yuan/mt, also down 5 yuan/mt from yesterday. According to an SMM survey, on December 11, the operaƟng rate of blast furnaces in 242 steel mills surveyed by SMM was 86.23%, down 2.71 percentage points MoM. The daily pig iron producƟon of the sample steel mills was 2.3626 million mt, down 47,500 mt MoM. Recently, due to environmental protecƟon-driven producƟon restricƟons in Hebei, many blast furnaces in steel mills have been shut down, leading to a signiﬁcant decline in pig iron producƟon. This has caused iron ore prices to ﬂuctuate downward. Considering that important meeƟngs are sƟll being held recently, the downward space for iron ore is relaƟvely limited. AƩenƟon should be paid to the impact of economic meeƟng content on market senƟment.
